ask.refusal: {tool} is off in Aico: the owner is asked through Needs you, one channel for every agent. Run: tether ask create "<one line that stands alone>" --option A --option B --recommend 1 [--blocking] [--body-file PATH] (up to 5 options; --blocking only if you stop and wait; add --body-file for long context). Then keep doing the work you can finish. The answer arrives as a message in this session; run tether ask done ID once you act on it.

github_pat_hint: GitHub 403 (gh PAT lacks admin scope): get a 30-min grant (the owner taps once) with aico grants request github-admin --reason '<what, in owner words>' --wait, then aico grants run github-admin -- gh ...; never print the credential.
